implementation_notes.result_signing: Off-chain ECDSA P-256 + SHA256 signing via committee.CommitteeNode.Sign; chaincode currently checks base64 format and signature count only. committeeSize=3 nodes each sign the SHA256 digest of matched pairs.
implementation_notes.settlement: RunSecureCSUpdate + explicit computation of matched quantity, Δ, FP, costs. Uses exported committee package functions.
implementation_notes.sharing: Additive secret sharing, n-of-n, not Shamir. splitAdditiveShares is a prototype benchmark implementation replicating committee/node.go:splitIntoShares (unexported). Fields shared: AP, CS, QT, OS.
implementation_notes.sorting_matching: Reconstruct ranking values inside committee, then sort.Slice (via committee.RunSecureSort) and AP_buyer >= AP_seller comparison (via committee.RunSecureMatch); not oblivious sort or secure comparison.
implementation_notes.total: Wall-clock time around the complete workflow (sharing→sort/match→settlement→signing); not the arithmetic sum of phase averages.
